profile_text.body:
Murf is an AI voice and conversational agent platform that describes itself as trusted by more than 10 million developers, businesses, and creators. The platform covers text-to-speech generation, AI dubbing, and the deployment of conversational agents for inbound and outbound calls and chat, with stated support for more than 35 languages including English, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, and others.

The company's core product, Murf.ai, is built around two proprietary speech models. Falcon 2 is described as the company's lowest-latency text-to-speech model, designed for real-time conversations using a compute-efficient neural architecture. Gen2 is positioned as a customization-first model intended for voiceover generation, offering controls for tone, pacing, and emphasis. Murf Agents are presented as purpose-built conversational agents designed for low-latency, multilingual interactions across industries, with escalation to human agents when required. The site also notes that content generated with Murf voices can be used for commercial purposes, including on platforms such as YouTube.

The site's held facts confirm that Murf maintains a tracked profile on theworldofai.org, with Murf.ai listed in the Voice and Audio category under voice synthesis. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are currently on file for the company.
